Name: Ali's Building Recolours (updated 25-5)
Author: strawberrymilk95
Description:
I did this as a personal project for myself and decided to share it!

I was inspired by the bright desert aesthetic and wanted something summery and beach house-y

credit to [b]Lumisteria and Barfyscorpian for a couple of sprites I modified from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/342/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D342%26preview%3D&pUp=1]here [/url]and [url=http://http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/barfys-fancy-farmhouses-and-other-addons-update-5-walls-and-floors.112984/]here[/url] 
[/b]
NOTE: because I wanted to make the final upgrade of the house symmetrical because I like symmetry the door placement and the stairs are a little off which you can see in the attached images. This doesn't really bother me but I just thought I would mention it!
